meta.description: Daily curated Claude AI skills news for small and medium businesses

entries.title: Claude Billing Changes Today: Agent SDK Separated from Subscription Credits — What SMBs Must Do Before June 15
entries.summary: Effective today, June 15, Anthropic unbundles Agent SDK and claude-p usage from Pro/Max/Team/Enterprise subscription pools. Heavy automation users previously had a 15-30x subsidy that now ends — you'll get a monthly dollar credit billed at standard API rates instead. SMB owners running Claude agents or headless workflows need to re-budget immediately or their automations will cost far more than expected.

entries.title: Anthropic Releases Claude Fable 5 — Mythos-Class Model Now Available to the Public With Cyber Safeguards
entries.summary: Claude Fable 5 (public tier) and Claude Mythos 5 (restricted) launched June 9, both at $10M input / $50M output tokens — less than half the earlier preview price. For SMBs: included on Pro/Max/Team/Enterprise at no extra cost through June 22, then moves to usage credits. Fable 5 is designed for complex reasoning and coding tasks; the safety layer means it can't be repurposed for cyberattacks.

entries.title: SBA-Hosted Free Workshop: 'AI for Small Business — Getting Started with Claude as Your Virtual Team Member' (Houston, TX)
entries.summary: The SBA's Small Business Development Center is hosting a free Aug 5 workshop in Houston teaching SMB owners how to use Claude.ai as a virtual team member. Covers prompt writing, uploading business documents for customized outputs, choosing the right model for tasks, and building repeatable AI workflows. Free registration required — ideal for Dallas-Fort Worth area owners traveling south.

entries.title: Taskade Publishes 'What Are Claude Skills?' — A No-Code Beginner Guide Updated for June 2026
entries.summary: A plain-English guide explaining Claude Skills as reusable folders loaded on demand via progressive disclosure, plus a no-code Taskade equivalent for non-technical SMB owners. If you've heard about Claude Skills but never dug in, this is the lowest-friction entry point available right now.

entries.title: LinkedIn Pro Tips: Build Claude Skills to Offload Cheap AI Tasks and Save on Usage Costs
entries.summary: Practical advice from an MSP professional on how building custom Claude Skills lets you route cheap, repetitive AI tasks into reusable skills while reserving expensive model calls for complex work. SMB owners: the cost-saving comes from reducing raw prompt counts by encoding your workflows as skills that Claude auto-activates.

entries.title: Claude Cowork: 9 Automations That Work — From Problem Statements to Branded Presentations (Full Guide)
entries.summary: A comprehensive walkthrough of 9 Claude Cowork automations, including generating branded presentations from plain-English problem statements and using Microsoft Office format skills. SMB owners: this shows how to go from idea to polished deliverable without touching PowerPoint — Claude Cowork's dedicated Skills handle the formatting layer natively.
